_help._file: The computer opponents' characters (the AI module, src/ai/kit). Each turn a bot rolls its goals in order: a goal wins when a d100 roll is under its trait's value (picked inside the range). The Dev Kit's AI tab edits these.
_help.traits.aggression: How often it goes for a win (the WIN goal).
_help.traits.caution: How often it stops your three in a row (the BLOCK goal).
_help.traits.planning: How often it plays for a good square (the BUILD goal: centre, corners, two in a row).
_help.nudge: How much the goals it didn't roll still count (0-1).
_help.focus: At a big moment (a win is there) how single-minded it is (0-1). 1 = it never misses a win it can see.
_help.chattiness: 0-100: how likely it is to say something (lines in content/text/en.json "banter").
